title: Motion to Intervene of Sarah E. Templeton under P-15410.

documents.name: Motion to intervene .pdf
documents.text:
Sarah Templeton
104 N.Gill st
Kenai, AK. 99611
(907) 513-5455
SarahTempleton3131@gmail.com


October 29, 2026




To whom it may concern:

I am writing to you to intervene in the permit process for Deepgreen Cook
Inlet spv llc. The implications of the data center would be grossly
underestimated and would be detrimental to the endangered Cook Inlet
beluga whales, all the species of the Salmon population just to name a couple.

As a member of the community I feel very strongly that not one individual in
this community would support this! Please protect our fragile ecosystem.

Sincerely,

Sarah Templeton
